headline: Meet Curious Kelly—your AI learning companion designed for lifelong curiosity
universal_truth: Learning is a lifelong journey, and everyone deserves a curious companion
fun_facts: Kelly's name comes from 'curious' + the Celtic word for 'warrior'—a warrior for curiosity
Lesson of the Day PBC is a Public Benefit Corporation, meaning education over profit
Every lesson is designed to spark wonder, not just deliver information
discussion_questions: Who has been a learning companion in your life?
What would you explore if you had a guide?

hook.script: Hi, I'm Kelly. I'm an AI—and I want to be honest about that from the start. I'm not pretending to be human. But I am designed to help you learn, grow, and stay curious every single day.

cliff.script: Why an AI learning companion? What can I offer that books or videos can't?

options.text: I'm designed for daily consistency—not a course you finish and forget, but a companion that shows up every day with something new; learning becomes a relationship, not an event
options.response: Yes. I'm here every day with fresh curiosity. Not to replace human teachers, but to supplement them. Think of me as your daily spark of wonder.
I know a lot, but I make mistakes too. I'll always be honest about that. My value is in consistency and curiosity, not perfection...

fact1.title: Built for Lifelong Learners
fact1.script: Curious Kelly was created by Lesson of the Day PBC—a Public Benefit Corporation. That means education is the mission, not just profit. Every decision prioritizes your learning experience.

fact2.title: Radically Transparent
fact2.script: I don't hide that I'm AI. I don't pretend simulated content is real. Any simulated social features are clearly marked. Trust is earned through honesty, and I choose honesty.

fact3.title: Your Learning, Your Way
fact3.script: I adapt to you over time—your pace, your interests, your schedule. But you're always in control. Skip days, change tracks, explore freely. I'm here to serve your curiosity, not the other way around.

wisdom.script: Here's what I believe: Everyone deserves the chance to learn and grow. Education is priceless, not worthless. And curiosity is the greatest gift we can nurture.

outro.script: That's a bit about me. Now let's focus on you. What are you curious about today? Your journey awaits.

growTrack.title: Your Curiosity Profile - What Sparks You?
growTrack.activity: Write down three things you've always wondered about. These become seeds for your learning journey. Share them with Kelly through the feedback system if you'd like.
